SpecVersion.description: The portable chart spec version this document conforms to.

Mark.description: The mark (geometric primitive) used to render the chart. Restricted to the intersection of native charting vocabularies.

FieldType.description: The declared type of an encoded field. Interpreters reconstruct typed values from this declaration, never by sniffing JSON values.

field.description: The name of the field in each datum that this channel reads.

Channel.description: A field-to-channel mapping with an explicit declared type.

field.description: The name of the field in each datum that this channel reads.

Channel_1.description: Spec 1.1: the end of a range on x. With mark "bar", each bar spans x to x2. Same type as x, quantitative or temporal.

field.description: The name of the field in each datum that this channel reads.

Channel_2.description: Spec 1.1: the end of a range on y. With mark "bar", each bar spans y to y2. Same type as y, quantitative or temporal.

Encoding.description: Field-to-channel mappings describing how data maps to visual channels.

DatumValue.description: A single value inside a data row: a flat JSON primitive.

Datum.description: A single data row: a flat record of JSON primitives.

InlineData.description: Inline data: small datasets embedded directly in the spec.

DataRefKind.description: The kind of external data reference: a live query, another content node, or a URL.

id.description: Identifier of the referenced dataset (query id, node id, or URL).

DataRef.description: A reference to an externally stored dataset, resolved by the host.

Data.description: The chart data: exactly one of inline values or an external reference.

DomainValue.description: A domain entry: a number for quantitative, an ISO 8601 string for temporal, or a category value for ordinal/nominal.

nice.description: Round the domain to human-friendly values.

zero.description: Force the domain to include zero.

ScaleHint.description: Optional scale hints. Interpreters may infer or override these.

tooltip.description: Whether tooltips are enabled. A trivial declarative hint — real interaction is per-platform application code, not document data.

Extensions.description: Web-only, non-portable hints. Native interpreters ignore this entirely.

ChartSpec.title: Portable Chart Specification
ChartSpec.description: A renderer-agnostic, framework-agnostic, language-neutral chart description. Grammar-of-graphics level: mark + encodings + declared data types + data reference.
